verdictBasis: §12 requires, before the first call, that the conservative projected total be <= $11.50 AND <= the current gateway balance. Under the committed methodology of docs/phase-3-final-chewy/02-cost-preflight.json, applied unchanged, the conservative total is $15.8309 - $4.33 over the cap and $3.27 over the $12.559204 balance. Independently of the safety factor, the worst-observed-rate total with NO padding ($12.6648) already exceeds the balance, so a started run had no headroom against a worst-case draw. The estimator was not weakened to fit, and no partial run was attempted because §14 forbids fix-and-continue and §12 pre-registers this exact outcome.
